# Universal Action Center

The Action Center projects obligations already recorded in canonical registers.
It never invents work and never holds state of its own.

## Ordering factors, in priority order

1. safety-security-privacy-accessibility-stop
2. governance-gate-blocker
3. release-critical-dependency
4. harm-to-learner-customer-or-enterprise
5. binding-commitment
6. due-date
7. cross-stream-dependency
8. strategic-importance

## Refused ordering factors

- user activity frequency
- engagement score
- employee productivity score
- opaque model ranking
